verdict.rationale: The evidence pack never documents a diff view of an agent's code changes or a gate that holds changes before a pull request is created. The configurable action approvals in omnara-docs-8 are a related but different control, so they earn no credit here. One community comment also notes that reviewing agent-written code is still unsolved by tools like this.

support.subject: As a developer, I can review a diff of an agent's changes and approve it before it becomes a pull request
